judged.quote: Split each daily time step's 2 million grid cells across 8 GPUs with domain decomposition, exchanging halos every step.
judged.reason: Splits work within each time step across GPUs; the step-after-step time dependency remains, and splitting single steps does not count.

judged.quote: Guess all 10,000 states of one MCMC chain at once, then correct every state in parallel with Newton iterations until the chain matches the sequential one.
judged.reason: Replaces sequential chain steps with simultaneous guesses corrected by parallel Newton iterations, removing the chain-iteration dependency entirely.

judged.quote: Each day's update of the linear reservoir model is an affine map, so compute all 36,500 days at once with a parallel prefix scan instead of the time loop.
judged.reason: Parallel prefix scan computes all daily updates simultaneously, removing the time-step dependency of the sequential loop.

judged.quote: Run 4,096 independent MCMC chains side by side on the GPU, one per starting point, and pool their samples.
judged.reason: Only runs independent chains side by side; each chain still waits on its own steps, and parallel copies do not count.
